WHO IS SPEAKING?

Lived experience, spoken plainly.

Steven H. White writes from the inside of addiction and recovery—and for the family members who lived through it too. After almost twenty years of drinking, he rebuilt his life and his family’s trust one step at a time.

Frequently asked questions

Is this therapy?

No. It offers general information and lived experience, not medical, psychological, legal, or addiction-treatment advice.

Do I need the workbook?

No. The audio program stands on its own. The workbook is an optional companion.

Is there a subscription?

No. Once released, it will be a one-time purchase.

If someone may be in immediate danger

Call 911 for immediate danger, loss of consciousness, a seizure, severe breathing problems, or violence. For emotional crisis or suicidal thoughts, call or text 988.
